sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS The exchange offer is intended to satisfy our obligations under the registration rights agreement we entered into in connection with the private offering of
the Old Notes. We will not receive any proceeds from the issuance of the New Notes in the exchange offer. In consideration for issuing the New Notes as contemplated in this prospectus, we will receive, in exchange, outstanding Old Notes in like
principal amount. We will cancel all of the Old Notes surrendered in exchange for New Notes in the exchange offer. As a result, the issuance of the New Notes will not result in any increase or decrease in our indebtedness. 12 Table of Contents DESCRIPTION OF OTHER INDEBTEDNESS The following is a summary of our material outstanding indebtedness.
